text:
Evelyn Tran: Heads-up: Helios MVP scope call. We need to decide telemetry & usage dashboards for MVP vs v1. Proposal: remove full multi-tenant dashboards from MVP and deliver a trimmed "pilot insights" API + CSV export. Keep May 17 ship window.
Carlos Mendes: Customer signal: two pilots (Acme & ByteCo) requested dashboards. Can pilot insights be sufficient?
Priya Shah: If we provide an embeddable CSV viewer + scheduled export hook, pilots can build quick dashboards themselves. Less perceived regression if labeled "pilot insights (limited)".
Owen Park: Estimates: API + export ~1.5w backend, tiny frontend wrapper iframe ~1w, QA 0.5w. Full dashboards add ~3.5w. So option A (trim) preserves date.
Evelyn Tran: rollout criteria proposal: 1) no P0 on pilot traffic for 72h, 2) p95 API latency <220ms, 3) export success rate >99.5%, 4) rollback if dataplane error rate >1% during canary. Any objections?
Carlos Mendes: add comms requirement: call out retention (MVP=7d) and missing historical charts. I'll handle email to pilots.
Priya Shah: dev asks: feature flag helios.telemetry_mode=pilot, telemetry_retention_days=7, cache_mode=light. We'll stub long-term retention to avoid infra churn.
product-bot: created ticket INF-3444 "Helios: MVP pilot insights vs full dashboards" https://redwood.internal/INF-3444 (owners: Evelyn, Owen, Carlos).
Evelyn Tran: Decision: Option A (pilot insights) to keep milestone. Recon Friday post-canary to decide v1 priority. :thumbsup:
